newsitem.title: ITALY: Central Italy paralysed by snow storms.
newsitem.headline: Central Italy paralysed by snow storms.

text.p: Much of central Italy was brought to a standstill on Sunday by heavy snow storms, with many roads blocked and villages cut off.

Local authorities said the central region of Umbria was paralysed by severe wintry conditions, while the main motorway which connects Rome to the north of the country was blocked in Tuscany by drifting snow.
After an unusually warm Christmas, Arctic air swept into Italy driving the temperature down to minus 30 Celsius (minus 22 Fahrenheit) in the northern mountains.
The east of the country suffered most from the deep chill. The Venice lagoon froze and snow fell on the Adriatic resorts of Rimini and Ancona for the first time in years.
Snow was also reported in Rome and soon turned to freezing rain, causing delays at Fiumicino airport.
Pope John Paul on Sunday sympathised with frozen pilgrims who braved the cold to listen to his open air Angelus message at his residence in the hills south of Rome.
"It seems the world is cold, also here in Italy, but more so in the north. I hope you are courageous in the face of the cold. Warm yourselves up," he said.
